text:
Aria: Heads-up  prospect (healthcare) requesting an on-prem sealed-network POC. They want delivery options (couriered USB vs. approved jumpbox pull), SBOM + signing provenance, expected upgrade cadence, and commercial uplift. Need a concise answer.

Tom: Quick: we support both couriered encrypted USB and pull-from-staging. Which do they prefer for initial seed?

Rafael (customer): Prefer physical courier for seed, then signed minibundles over an internal staging host. CVE SLA: 30 days for critical.

Pri: OK. We can produce a full signed bundle (~12GB) for courier and minibundles (<200MB) for security patches. For limited-transfer sites we shard into 500MB chunks and provide sha256 manifest + reassembly tool.

Mira: Timing: standard cadence we recommend = monthly security minibundles + quarterly feature rollups. Emergency hotfixes available (48-72h) as a paid expedited channel.

Tom: Commercials: one-time packaging & signing fee + PS for chunking/testing (est 10-16hrs) + concierge support uplift (~15%) for first 90 days. I'll draft numbers.

LegalBot: For questionnaire wording propose: "We provide a redacted SBOM and signer certificate chain. Signing is performed inside FIPS 140-2/3 HSMs; private keys never leave the HSM. HSM attestation and redacted audit logs can be provided under NDA."

OpsBot: Note on offline activation: offline license tokens are supported. We'll include token generator + CLI import steps in the runbook.

Pri: Verification snippet we can share with compliance:
```
# verify chunks -> verify signature -> reassemble
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-sign verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
cat part_* > bundle.tar.gz && tar -tzf bundle.tar.gz
```

Mira: Also call out cert rotation: offline rekey supported but needs signed rotation bundle and a maintenance window; recommend quarterly rotations unless they require otherwise.

Aria: Plan: Tom to produce quote lines and PS estimate; Pri + OpsBot to assemble a 1-page runbook, chunker script, and sanitized SBOM; LegalBot to finalize the questionnaire text. I'll compile and send reply by EOD. Any blockers?

Rafael: Compliance will need the sanitized SBOM and signer cert within 48 hours for internal approval. No other blockers. Thanks. :pray:
